raw_aggregate_algorithm: source sorted raw absolute path + NUL + lowercase sha256 + LF; cannot recompute raw path digest from redacted prefix without original private mapping
public_aggregate_algorithm: reconstruct normalized prefix+suffix, sort normalized full paths, concatenate path + NUL + lowercase SHA256 + LF, then SHA256; content hashes are unchanged
scope: All 4889 declared inputs represented once; no interpreter, wheel, binary, tokenizer, or third-party source bytes included. Runtime mapped files are separate post-import observations.
